# Punch List — M6.P2 T5, the build engine

**DRAFT, before Phase 4.6.** The two reviewers' passes wait for the host; their grades may add, re-grade or withdraw items. No issue is filed until they are graded (brief § 8). Generated by `tools/punch-items.py` from one list, so the items, the `punch_index` and the Phase 7 table agree. Upstream contribution candidates (#585) are marked; submissions are deferred (D-WORKFLOW-165).

---

## PL-01: `scripts/mkimage` reports success over an incomplete `qcom-abl` or `arm-efi` image

- **Severity:** High
- **Category:** Code Quality
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-16
- **Owner area:** image assembly: the disk image writer
- **What:** Guard the four copies in the `arm-efi` and `qcom-abl` branches with `>"${SAVE_ERROR}" 2>&1 || show_error` as every other branch does; check `pigz` the same way; end with the status of the work (`exit 0` only after the checksum is written), not `cleanup`'s.
- **Where:** `scripts/mkimage:252-255,270-273,324,333-334`
- **Evidence:** the read of every `mcopy` site (`02` F-16); `projects/ROCKNIX/devices/SM8550/options:34` (`qcom-abl`)
- **Can this be done on the VM?** No: GENERIC_X64 is `syslinux`; a sandbox of the branch with `mtools` and a too-small FAT image shows the refusal, and the SM8550 build proves the image (fix-pending-image)
- **Already written:** nothing on devices to migrate: an incomplete image either failed to boot or was never flashed; whether any SM8550 image in the record was incomplete is not checked here (its `SYSTEM` size against the FAT partition would say)
- **Acceptance:** A sandboxed run of `scripts/mkimage`'s `qcom-abl` branch over a FAT image too small for `SYSTEM` exits non-zero and prints `image: An error has occurred...`; the next SM8550 build's `target/` holds its image and sidecar with `build.rc` 0.
- **Upstream:** a #585 candidate (D-WORKFLOW-164; submission deferred, D-WORKFLOW-165)

## PL-02: `scripts/get_git` accepts a cached clone whose `HEAD` is not `PKG_VERSION`

- **Severity:** High
- **Category:** Code Quality
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-18
- **Owner area:** the source fetch: git sources
- **What:** In `_repo_exists_and_valid`, compare `git rev-parse HEAD` with `PKG_VERSION` (full hash, or the prefix the recipe gives) instead of `git ls-remote . | grep`; on a mismatch fall through to the re-clone (or `git reset --hard` after a fetch).
- **Where:** `scripts/get_git:36,198`
- **Evidence:** P13 (`tools/sb-get-git-head.sh`)
- **Can this be done on the VM?** No: a fetch on the build host; `tools/sb-get-git-head.sh` is the agent-verifiable artifact (fix-sandbox), the first build after the merge the image proof
- **Already written:** source caches under `sources/` and `/workspace/cache/rocknix-sources` may hold clones whose `HEAD` is not their recipe's pin; the fixed check finds each at the next fetch and re-clones it; images already built from a stale clone are corrected by their next build
- **Acceptance:** `tools/sb-get-git-head.sh` run against the fixed check prints `refused` for `PKG_VERSION=A` with `HEAD` at B, and `accepted` for `PKG_VERSION=B`.
- **Upstream:** a #585 candidate (D-WORKFLOW-164; submission deferred, D-WORKFLOW-165)

## PL-03: `scripts/get_env` keeps secret-shaped names `DROP` misses, and a value with a newline writes lines of its own into `.env`

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Security
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-01, F-02
- **Owner area:** the container's environment: `get_env`
- **What:** Match `DROP` case-insensitively, add `PASS`, `PASSPHRASE`, `COOKIE`, `SESSION` and fused `*TOKEN`/`*KEY` names, keep `KEEP` as is; skip (and name on stderr) any variable whose value contains a newline. The `get_env` comment says what is and is not filtered, including #644 finding 3's two guide variables.
- **Where:** `scripts/get_env:2-21`; `Makefile:205-208`
- **Evidence:** P1 (`tools/sb-get-env.sh`)
- **Can this be done on the VM?** No: the build host's shell and docker; `tools/sb-get-env.sh` is the artifact (fix-sandbox); a Docker build after the merge shows nothing the build needs was dropped (fix-pending-image)
- **Already written:** nothing at rest: `.env` is removed when each container exits and none exists in any of the 134 checkouts (`02` § Mechanical checks); nothing to migrate
- **Acceptance:** `tools/sb-get-env.sh` prints none of `DB_PASS`, `SSHPASS`, `DOCKERHUBTOKEN`, `github_token`, `MY_PASSPHRASE`, `SESSION_COOKIE`, `MULTILINE` or a bare `OTHER_TOKEN` line, and still prints `PROJECT`, `DEVICE`, `ARCH` and `SCREENSCRAPER_DEV_LOGIN`.

## PL-04: `add_es_system` carries one system's fragment into the next: `daphne` and `gp32` ship the wrong year, and a system appended after `imageviewer` would launch nothing

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Code Quality
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-03
- **Owner area:** the launch table: `add_es_system`
- **What:** Unset the ten `SYSTEM_*` keys and `SYSTEM_COMMAND` at the top of `add_es_system`; give `config/emulators/daphne.conf` and `gp32.conf` their `SYSTEM_RELEASE` (1983, 2001) and `arcade.conf`, `segamodel3.conf` their `SYSTEM_WIKI_PATH`.
- **Where:** `distributions/ROCKNIX/config/functions:127-142`; `config/emulators/{daphne,gp32,arcade,segamodel3}.conf`
- **Evidence:** P6, P7
- **Can this be done on the VM?** Yes: the host regeneration (`tools/regen-es-systems.sh`) shows the table; the guest shows the year in the system view after the build (fix-pending-image for the two shipped lines)
- **Already written:** every image built carries `release="1996"` for both systems; the table is regenerated at each image and nothing on a device stores it, so the next image corrects it; nothing to migrate
- **Acceptance:** The regeneration for all five devices gives `daphne` `1983` and `gp32` `2001`, and the case C fixture (`tools/sb-es-cases.sh`) gives the appended system the default `runemu.sh` command; every other line of the five tables is unchanged.
- **Upstream:** a #585 candidate (D-WORKFLOW-164; submission deferred, D-WORKFLOW-165)

## PL-05: The launch table's one-default rule stops a build silently on two `true` lines and ships two defaults when a `false` core comes first

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Code Quality
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-04
- **Owner area:** the launch table: the default core
- **What:** Mark only the core just added (`.../cores/core[last()]`); let `mk_es_systems` print `xmlstarlet fo`'s error and fail by name.
- **Where:** `distributions/ROCKNIX/config/functions:113,209-215`
- **Evidence:** P4, P5 (T3's F-06 cases rerun)
- **Can this be done on the VM?** Yes: the host regeneration (fix-sandbox); the shipped tables are byte-identical before and after
- **Already written:** nothing: no shipped table has either shape (T3's five tables)
- **Acceptance:** Case A fails with a message naming the duplicate attribute, case B ships one default (`b2`), and the five devices' regenerated tables are byte-identical to today's.
- **Upstream:** a #585 candidate (D-WORKFLOW-164; submission deferred, D-WORKFLOW-165)

## PL-06: `build_distro` prunes the device's outputs before `scripts/image`, so an identity's bytes can be replaced on the documented route

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Interaction Defect
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-09
- **Owner area:** the identity: `build_distro` x `scripts/image`
- **What:** Refuse in `build_distro`, before the prune, when `BUILD_TIMESTAMP` is set and `target/` already holds an output of that identity; or prune only outputs of another timestamp. The stream brief chooses.
- **Where:** `scripts/build_distro:82-84`; `scripts/image:78-82`
- **Evidence:** the trace in `02` F-09; three M7 `target/` directories
- **Can this be done on the VM?** No: a device build on the host; a sandbox of `build_distro`'s prune and the image's refusal over a fixture `target/` (fix-sandbox), then a rebuild with a frozen timestamp (fix-pending-image)
- **Already written:** candidates live in the immutable store, which `build_distro` never touches; a `target/` replaced in the past is not detectable now; nothing to migrate
- **Acceptance:** With `BUILD_TIMESTAMP` set and a matching output in a fixture `target/`, the sandboxed `build_distro` prune-and-image sequence refuses and leaves the existing files byte-identical.

## PL-07: A device-level file that `find_file_path` reads is outside the stamp: a device's firmware list can change without a rebuild

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Code Quality
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-17
- **Owner area:** the stamp: `calculate_stamp` x `find_file_path`
- **What:** List `devices/${DEVICE}/config` (the files the recipe reads) in `kernel-firmware`'s `PKG_NEED_UNPACK` (T8's recipe); the engine-wide option (hash what `find_file_path` returned) is the stream brief's to weigh.
- **Where:** `config/functions:1109-1129,1188-1191`; `projects/ROCKNIX/packages/linux-firmware/kernel-firmware/package.mk:10,39`
- **Evidence:** P12 (`tools/sb-stamp-device-config.sh`)
- **Can this be done on the VM?** No: a build's stamp; `tools/sb-stamp-device-config.sh` is the artifact (fix-sandbox)
- **Already written:** nothing on devices: no device's firmware list has changed since the base (`git log` empty); a build root built before a future edit would keep its old firmware set, which the fix forces to rebuild
- **Acceptance:** `tools/sb-stamp-device-config.sh` with the recipe's fixed `PKG_NEED_UNPACK` prints that the stamp moved.

## PL-08: Archives are fetched without TLS verification and accepted unhashed when a recipe has no `PKG_SHA256`

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Security
- **Question:** Q3
- **Source Finding:** F-19
- **Owner area:** the source fetch: archives
- **What:** Drop `--no-check-certificate`; refuse (or warn loudly, the stream brief's choice) an archive with no `PKG_SHA256`; fix `update_packages` to write the new checksum rather than delete the old one.
- **Where:** `scripts/get_archive:25,45`; `scripts/update_packages:50-61`
- **Evidence:** the read in `02` F-19
- **Can this be done on the VM?** No: a download on the build host; a sandbox of `get_archive`'s acceptance over a fixture with an empty `PKG_SHA256` (fix-sandbox); a full build after the merge shows every source still fetches (fix-pending-image)
- **Already written:** `sources/` holds archives accepted unverified; their bytes are not re-checked by the fix unless their recipe gains a checksum (T7's and T8's count of recipes without one); nothing to migrate
- **Acceptance:** A sandboxed `get_archive` with an empty `PKG_SHA256` refuses (or prints the chosen warning), and its `wget` line carries no `--no-check-certificate`.
- **Upstream:** a #585 candidate (D-WORKFLOW-164; submission deferred, D-WORKFLOW-165)

## PL-09: `scripts/checkdeps` changes the build host: the default compiler and `/nix`, with `sudo`, on every entry

- **Severity:** Medium
- **Category:** Code Quality
- **Question:** Q2
- **Source Finding:** F-20
- **Owner area:** host preparation: `checkdeps`
- **What:** Report what is needed and stop, or act only under an explicit opt-in variable; never switch `update-alternatives` or create `/nix` unasked.
- **Where:** `scripts/checkdeps:296-309,324-345`
- **Evidence:** the read in `02` F-20
- **Can this be done on the VM?** No: the build host; a sandbox with `sudo` and `update-alternatives` shims on `PATH` records whether they are called (fix-sandbox)
- **Already written:** on a Debian or Ubuntu host with gcc-12, an earlier run may already have set the default compiler; the fix does not undo it, and the owner is told in its message
- **Acceptance:** A sandboxed `checkdeps` with shimmed `sudo` and `update-alternatives` calls neither unless the opt-in is set.
